audit_red_flags.statement: Documentation created after the fact rather than contemporaneously with the decision — national competent authorities apply the contemporaneous standard.
No clear version control / traceability between document versions and system versions.
No compliance matrix mapping each requirement to the specific evidence that satisfies it.
Accuracy levels/metrics not declared in the instructions for use.
Relying on the Article 6(3) 'not significant risk' exception without a documented justification.
Deployer does not retain the automatically-generated logs of the high-risk system within its control.

common_mistakes.mistake: Declaring one headline accuracy number with no metric definition, test conditions or threshold rationale.
common_mistakes.correction: Declare the specific metric(s), the conditions/test set, and why the level is appropriate for the intended purpose.

common_mistakes.mistake: Assembling the technical file just before assessment.
common_mistakes.correction: Maintain it as a living document from development onward; contemporaneous records are the standard.

common_mistakes.mistake: Assuming that landing in an Annex III domain automatically makes the system high-risk.
common_mistakes.correction: The system must also perform one of the specific functions listed for that domain; otherwise it is not high-risk via 6(2).

common_mistakes.mistake: Believing Article 50 transparency duties apply only to high-risk systems.
common_mistakes.correction: Article 50 applies to any system in its four situations regardless of high-risk status.
